h1: Custom Xlarge Buttons for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom xlarge buttons in bulk. Perfect for events, promotions, and branding. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Custom xlarge buttons, typically 3 inches in diameter, offer a bold canvas for your logo, message, or design. They stand out on bags, jackets, and lanyards at trade shows, rallies, or team events. Choose from round or square shapes and add a pin back for easy wear. Screen printing or full-color offset decoration ensures your artwork pops. Order in bulk to outfit your staff or distribute as giveaways that attendees will actually keep and wear.
heroAltText: Custom xlarge buttons with full-color printed logos, 3 inch diameter, ideal for bulk promotional orders
